goal: EFI -> DarwinBoot -> XNU entry: prove on the handset that XNU took control.

criteria.requirement: A log transport exists and is implemented: either a GOP framebuffer console written after ExitBootServices, or a reserved RAM mailbox read back by a diagnostic EFI application. Without one, a successful XNU entry and a hang look identical on a phone with no serial port.
criteria.note: Undecided and unimplemented. The GOP framebuffer avenue is currently scheduled in P3, which is why this criterion blocks P1 rather than P3.

criteria.requirement: The checkpoint set is a single machine-readable list (arm_vm_init, crypto self-test, PE_init_iokit and the rest the QEMU fixture already asserts) shared by the fixture, the transport and the handset record.
criteria.note: docs/native-checkpoints.json carries nine checkpoints, each with a marker, the kernel symbol it is observed on and the fixture milestone it maps to; scripts/test-native-xnu-entry.py builds every breakpoint from checkpoint_symbols() in that file, so a milestone cannot drift from the symbol that proves it. check-checkpoints.py refuses an observable checkpoint without a symbol, test-checkpoints.py covers the contract, and test-xnu-entry-adt.py pins the fixture mapping. The transport that would write the markers on a handset is P1.1 and stays open.

criteria.requirement: The XNU early-boot QEMU fixture runs in CI and archives its report; today scripts/test-native-xnu-entry.py and test-handoff-qemu.py are only py_compile'd.
criteria.note: Run 44003233713 (job xnu-entry-qemu): the linked kernel boots through the menu and DarwinBoot under QEMU and reaches arm_vm_init, the source crypto POST (status 0), PE_init_iokit and kernel_bootstrap, with the report archived. Emulation only: emulator_only true, handset_boot_observed false. Locally (2026-11-17, QEMU 11.1.0) the fixture got further: with --smp 2 the GIC target probe passes, prepareLocal is reached, and the kernel enters bsd_init before panicking in pthread_init because the pthread kext never registers (docs/emulation/2026-11-17-local-qemu-bsd-init-panic.json). That local run is QEMU-tested, not a CI run, and every job stopped starting before its first step on 2026-11-17 (docs/ci/RUNS.md).

criteria.requirement: A handset record shows the checkpoint sequence reaching a named milestone, plus at least one negative case (a panic or a stop) that the same transport captured.
criteria.note: Requires P1.1 and P1.2. This is the criterion the roadmap called 'a real-device log proves XNU took control'.

criteria.requirement: The condition for removing board.toml's `example = true` guard is defined in exactly one place and the other documents reference it.
criteria.note: board.toml's header is now the single statement; AGENTS.md rule 10 and the roadmap's P1 line reference it instead of restating a different rule. This is the only definition change in this round, not a claim about the guard's condition being satisfied.
